d: Short, chin-length jet black hair with choppy layers and blunt-cut bangs frames a youthful face with wide, bright cornflower blue eyes. A slender build is dressed in a white zip-up athletic jacket with grey trim, a high dark grey collar, and a short pleated charcoal grey skirt. A brown leather satchel is slung across the shoulder, accompanied by a large, metallic grey industrial cylinder strapped to the back.
